description: Storefront Recent Orders panel: a new section on spa/index.html (outside the chat overlay) that polls GET /api/orders every ~10s, renders rows with status badges via textContent/createElement only (never innerHTML), and refreshes immediately after a chat-placed order via the data.placedOrder envelope. Keeps the five bound ids and chat/refund/receipt flows intact; all calls same-origin relative. Depends on FEAT-002 (the GET /api/orders contract) and FEAT-001 (the /api/chat placedOrder envelope). See design.md section 9.
steps:
In spa/index.html add a new
between the Menu section (#menu) and the footer (#contact), containing

Recent Orders

Live from the counter — refreshes automatically.

    (design.md section 9).
In spa/index.html add <script src="orders.js"></script> IMMEDIATELY AFTER the existing <script src="ui.js"></script> tag (no defer, matching the existing tags). Do not reorder app.js/ui.js.

Create spa/orders.js: at top-level evaluation (NOT inside DOMContentLoaded) assign window.refreshRecentOrders = refreshRecentOrders so the hook exists before any chat message can place an order. Define a pure renderOrders(listEl, orders) that clears the list and, for each order, builds a row with document.createElement and sets every field (orderId, summary, '$'+total, status) via node.textContent — NEVER innerHTML and never a template string assigned to innerHTML — and adds a status badge span with class badge + badge-received/badge-preparing/badge-ready based on order.status. Define refreshRecentOrders() that does fetch('/api/orders') (same-origin relative), parses JSON, and calls renderOrders(document.getElementById('recentOrders'), data.orders||[]); on non-OK response or network error it leaves the previously rendered list in place (no destructive clear). On DOMContentLoaded do one immediate refreshRecentOrders() then setInterval(refreshRecentOrders, 10000).

In spa/app.js sendMessage, AFTER the existing `if (data.pendingRefund ...)` block, add exactly: if (data.placedOrder && data.placedOrder.orderId) { append('sys', 'Order placed: ' + data.placedOrder.orderId + ' — ' + data.placedOrder.summary); if (window.refreshRecentOrders) window.refreshRecentOrders(); } — this is the ONLY edit to app.js; it is additive and must not touch the #log/#chatForm/#message/#orderId/#receiptBtn bindings or the refund/receipt code paths.

In spa/styles.css add .orders-list, .order-row, and .badge/.badge-received/.badge-preparing/.badge-ready rules using the existing coffee palette + accent #8c4fff; add a --ready: #2f9e5a variable (RECEIVED -> muted/caramel, PREPARING -> accent, READY -> green). No CDNs, no external fonts, no new JS dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: spa/index.html contains <section id="recent"> with <ul id="recentOrders"> between #menu and #contact, and <script src="orders.js"> appears immediately after the ui.js script tag.

spa/orders.js assigns window.refreshRecentOrders at top level, fetches '/api/orders' (relative), polls every 10000ms, and renderOrders sets all order fields via textContent/createElement with NO innerHTML anywhere in the file.
spa/app.js change is additive-only: the placedOrder block is present, the five bound ids are still queried/bound exactly as before, and the refund/receipt flows are untouched.
spa/styles.css has the orders-list/order-row/badge rules and a --ready green; no CDN/external-font/new-dependency references were added.
HARD INVARIANTS preserved: stored-XSS-safe rendering (textContent only); same-origin relative /api/... calls only; no change to chat/refund/receipt behavior.
verification: grep -n 'getElementById("log")\|getElementById("chatForm")\|getElementById("message")\|getElementById("orderId")\|getElementById("receiptBtn")' spa/app.js -> all five still present.
grep -n 'fetch("/api/orders")\|setInterval' spa/orders.js  -> same-origin relative fetch + 10s poll present.
grep -n 'placedOrder' spa/app.js  -> the additive block is present.
Full behavioral verification is covered live in FEAT-004 (no JS test runner exists in the repo).
findings:
Implemented the storefront Recent Orders panel (SPA-only, additive). spa/index.html: added <section id="recent" class="section"> (with <ul id="recentOrders" class="orders-list" aria-live="polite">) between #menu and the #contact footer, and <script src="orders.js"></script> immediately after the ui.js tag (no defer; app.js/ui.js order unchanged). spa/orders.js (new): top-level `window.refreshRecentOrders = refreshRecentOrders` assignment (outside DOMContentLoaded); pure renderOrders(listEl, orders) that clears via listEl.textContent='' and builds each row with document.createElement, setting orderId/summary/'$'+total/status via node.textContent ONLY (no innerHTML anywhere in the file — the only 'innerHTML' occurrences are in the header comment documenting the invariant); badgeClass() maps RECEIVED->badge badge-received, PREPARING->badge badge-preparing, READY->badge badge-ready; refreshRecentOrders() does same-origin relative fetch('/api/orders'), returns early on non-OK, and on network error leaves the previously rendered list in place (no destructive clear); DOMContentLoaded does one immediate refresh then setInterval(refreshRecentOrders, 10000). spa/app.js: ONLY edit is the additive placedOrder block appended AFTER the pendingRefund block in sendMessage (append sys 'Order placed: <id> — <summary>' + if(window.refreshRecentOrders) call); the five bound ids (#log,#chatForm,#message,#orderId,#receiptBtn) and the refund/receipt code paths are untouched. spa/styles.css: added --ready:#2f9e5a and .orders-list/.order-row/.order-id/.order-summary/.order-total plus .badge/.badge-received(caramel)/.badge-preparing(accent #8c4fff)/.badge-ready(green) rules using the existing palette; no CDNs/external fonts/new JS deps.

VERIFICATION: grep -n innerHTML spa/orders.js -> matches only in the comment, none in code. All five getElementById bindings still present in app.js. orders.js has fetch('/api/orders') (relative) + setInterval(...,10000). placedOrder block present and additive. index.html script order app.js/ui.js/orders.js; #recent + #recentOrders present between #menu and #contact. python3 -m pytest app/tests -q = 39 passed (unchanged from the FEAT-002 baseline — nothing broken elsewhere). HARD INVARIANTS preserved: stored-XSS-safe textContent-only rendering (no innerHTML for order data), same-origin relative /api/... calls only, chat/refund/receipt flows and the five bound ids intact.
